execution_readiness.claim_boundary: The cluster job produces pending evidence. Only the existing GM coordinator publishes it; a workstation verifier is read-only and may promote the already-built queue fragment to the control branch after authenticating that publication.

transport_authentication.git_executable_policy: Use only the source-pinned /usr/local/bin/git or /usr/bin/git after root-owner, non-writable file, directory, and confined symlink-chain validation; PATH is never consulted.
transport_authentication.environment_policy: Git subprocesses receive a fixed minimal environment. Caller Git config, helpers, SSH commands, dynamic-loader variables, HOME, netrc, proxy, and custom CA settings are not inherited.
transport_authentication.remote_policy: Control and results refs are fetched from the literal source-pinned HTTPS URL into fresh template-free bare repositories with system/global configuration disabled and exact code-generated local configuration. The results graph may retain only a code-generated literal-URL promisor stanza during bounded artifact reads; it is erased afterward. A configured checkout alias is reported but is not the transport trust root.
transport_authentication.claim_source_ancestry_rule: For every claim, descriptor.source_commit must be an ancestor of claim.control_commit, which must be an ancestor of the twice-observed authorized control head; the exact queue blob and normalized descriptor are read from that fetched history.
transport_authentication.coordinator_credentials_rule: The child never asserts credential or deploy-key availability. Only an actual authenticated coordinator publication and read-only remote round trip establish the result channel.

worker_attestation.selection_rule: The source-authenticated 32-worker deployment inventory is topology only, never scientific sample size. One bounded selected subset is released and authenticated exactly; omitted or Pending workers grant no capacity, while omission only reduces concurrency.
worker_attestation.attestation_id_rule: Every attestation job ID binds the lane and finalizer attempt plus one fixed-worker suffix. An expired or failed wave is immutable and a retry must use a new finalizer attempt; cross-attempt mixing is rejected.

attempt_inventory.zero_launch_rule: Aggregate and cleanup may be explicitly absent only when the complete derived runtime-root inventory is empty, every queue job in the attempt is terminal and child-reaped, at least one is non-success, and no native action, request, cell, failure, aggregate, terminal, or coordination artifact exists.

pending_publication.sole_active_job_rule: The semantic control set contains only the finalizer. The H1 verifier requires its observed outer result to be terminal and child-reaped.
pending_publication.generation_rule: The claim generation is a lower bound because the coordinator re-stages unchanged control each poll. H1 may use a greater generation only with identical namespace, control commit, admission deadline, shutdown flag, and active job set.
pending_publication.freshness_rule: Every worker attestation, reconciliation, pending receipt, and evidence receipt carries an explicit consume-by bound no later than 300 seconds after observation. The H1 verifier has no caller time override and uses its current UTC wall clock.
pending_publication.ancestry_rule: The verifier locates the unique first linear descendant of the observed ancestor whose tree contains the exact pending artifact. Intervening and later commits must be authenticated coordinator-only queue snapshots, may not rewrite immutable published artifacts, and the remote head must remain unchanged across two observations.
